gist: Health and fitness: knee rehab for patellofemoral pain with physio Helen Marsh at Northgate Physio. At the 6 Nov review she cleared a return-to-run plan: three 10-minute easy runs a week on flat routes, no hills until December, and keep the squats and step-downs. Gym sessions stay upper body only; cycling is fine and is used for the ride to Halcyon. Upcoming: next physio check on 18 Dec 2026 at 08:15. Open loops: none. Earlier tiredness and early nights were noted; an idea to run again in spring is only conditional on the knee.
